intent: To demonstrate the unequal distribution of vaccine doses globally, highlighting that high-income countries acquired the majority of supplies while lower-income countries received very few.

requirements.question: Must the video explicitly show high income exceeding 50%, or is a general 'majority' label enough?
Is the absolute 270 million count required, or is the 3.5% share sufficient to convey 'very few'?
Must the animation display the full four-group ranking, or only the high-vs-low contrast?

units.claim: High-income countries accounted for 54.44% of the relative dose share, i.e. over half (majority).
accept: High-income countries got 54.4% of doses, more than half.
Over half the doses (54.44%) went to high-income countries.
High income crossed the 50% majority threshold with a 54.44% share.
units.evidence: The High income bar/segment must be visibly labeled 54.44% (or 54.4%) and/or shown crossing a 50% reference line.

units.claim: Lower-income countries received 270,000,000 doses, only a 3.50% relative share.

basis.note: Absolute dose count for lower-income group.

accept: Lower-income countries received only 3.5% of doses (270 million).
Just 270 million doses went to lower-income countries, a 3.50% share.
units.evidence: The Lower income bar/segment must be labeled 270M and/or 3.5%.

units.claim: The dose shares decline in income order: High income 54.44% > Upper middle income 13.61% > Lower middle income 5.33% > Lower income 3.50%.
accept: Shares rank High 54.44% > Upper-middle 13.61% > Lower-middle 5.33% > Lower-income 3.50%.
Vaccine share falls as income group falls: 54.44%, 13.61%, 5.33%, 3.50%.
High income first with 54.44%, then upper-middle 13.61%, lower-middle 5.33%, lower-income last at 3.50%.
units.evidence: Bars/segments must be ordered by income group and show relative-share labels in descending order.

optional_valid: Lower-middle-income group received 411,000,000 doses, a 5.33% share.
High-income absolute value is 4.2 billion doses.
Lower-middle-income absolute value is 411 million doses.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
